detail.longDescription:
Morning weather check: 10 seconds, saves 20-minute problems later.

The 3-day forecast is more actionable than a 10-day (too uncertain) or just current conditions (you can look outside). 

I check it automatically by opening a new tab — weather is just there via Weather & Clock Dashboard.

https://addons.mozilla.org/en-US/firefox/addon/weather-clock-dashboard/

#Productivity #Morning
